items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: I never met him until 1920. I went out to his house to see what he arranged a number for me.

ctx.x: No, except the fastest over there. He studied piano with him for a while.

Well, he, somewhere, I don't know if you want to cut it off. No, it's all right. He was actually one of the real classic teachers in the audience. That's what Festus did. And his daughter is now Dean of the Department of Music at Wilberforce University. Is that the... Camille Nicholson. That's the daughter of the old professor. That's the daughter of the father. She's an old woman now, for that matter. How much is that now? No. He was... How much is that now? She's at Wilberforce. Huh? She's at Wilberforce in…
You must have studied with him back in 1905 or before, wasn't it, D-Fat? Yeah, he was. You remember when he was teaching me with? Huh?
